The '''Nightlands''', also known as the '''Darkside''', were the half of the tidally-locked [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in perpetual night. They were the counterpart to the [[Bright Lands]], which were in perpetual day. [[Crystal/Legends|Crystalline]] plants and predatory beasts lived there.

During the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the Nightlands were the site of a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course. By [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Tzidik Wrantojo]] was the track favorite.<ref name="RR">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightlands first appeared in the [[1997]] junior novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]'', written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]].<ref name="Jedi Bounty">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref> When Ryloth appeared on the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' in [[2009]], it was not depicted as being tidally locked, putting the existence of the Nightlands in question.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
